overview_description.description: ClaimSorted helps insurance companies outsource and streamline their claims operations by combining AI-driven automation with human oversight. It offers customizable First Notice of Loss (FNOL) workflows, fraud detection, compliance checks, structured claims data, and a branded claims portal for policyholders. The company works across lines such as auto, property, warranty, travel, health, and liability. It also offers consulting services in claims management, policy review, risk strategy, and regulatory support.

about_short_description.short_description: ClaimSorted is a insurtech company that develops an AI-powered claims management platform designed to act as a next-generation TPA.

product.name: Digital Claims TPA Platform
product.description: A platform that automates and manages insurance claims processing to reduce turnaround time and operational costs.

product.name: White-label eNOL and Claims Portal
product.description: Customizable digital interfaces for policyholders to submit and track claims under the insurer's brand.

product.name: Claims Assessment and Workflow Design
product.description: Customized claims workflows and eligibility checks based on insurer policy wording and claims philosophy.

product.name: Fraud Detection and Cost Containment
product.description: Algorithms and systems to identify fraudulent claims and control indemnity costs through real-time checks and pattern analysis.

product.name: Claims Reporting and Data Insights
product.description: Reporting tools and data feeds that provide actionable insights from claims data to support underwriting and risk management.
